latestVersion.changelog:
Caption Generator Meme 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly add AI-generated meme captions to your images and videos (up to 200MB, 1080p MP4 output).
- Works with MP4, MOV, GIF, WebM, and more; optimized for TikTok and social creators.
- Simple setup: automatic free token handling and session management.
- Upload, describe, and download your meme videos in 20–40 seconds using cloud GPUs.
- Built-in commands for exporting, checking credits, uploading, and reviewing timeline state.
